english.title: Communicate information obtained about ballot paper or voting at polling station
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) communicated to a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), information obtained in a polling station at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) as to the

(A)_[candidate for whom a voter in that station was about to vote or had voted]_
(B)_[registered political party towards the return of whose candidates a voter in that station was about to vote or had voted]_
(C)_[number on the back of the ballot paper given to a voter at that station]_
(D)_[unique identifying mark on the back of the ballot paper given to a voter at that station]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 66(3)(c) and (6) of the Representation of the People Act 1983.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Option B relates to an election of the London members of the London Assembly, as per subsection 66(7) of the Act.
